# Tajaran
Tajaran are a species of omnivorous, bipedal humanoids with features strongly resembling Terran felines. Their most distinguishing traits include a layer of fur, large ears atop their heads, and a tail that aids in balance.
## Benefits
- Their soft feet allow them to [color=#1e90ff]walk shoeless without making noise[/color]. - They can [color=#1e90ff]fit into duffel bags[/color]. - They use their claws for unarmed attacks, dealing [color=#ec3a3a]Slash[/color] and [color=#ec3a3a]Piercing[/color] damage. - Their layer of fur makes them take [color=#1e90ff]20% less Cold damage.[/color]
## Drawbacks
- Due to their small stature, Tajara take [color=#ffa500]15% more Brute damage.[/color] - They take [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage.[/color]
As a result of their eyes being more sensitive, they can [color=#1e90ff]see better in low-light conditions[/color], though not as well as shadowkin. However, this also means that [color=#ec3a3a]flashes have a stronger effect[/color] on them.
Thanks to their innate agility, they [color=#1e90ff]take reduced damage from impacts or falls[/color], and their soft feet allow them to [color=#1e90ff]walk shoeless without making noise[/color].
## Tajaran Naming Conventions
Tajaran have a naming convention heavily tied to their homeworld's languages and cultures, usually consisting of multiple syllables placed together. Occassionally these syllables are seperated by a apostrophe, typically coming after the letter "i" in a syllable, but this is not required. Names should not be so long that they are unintelligible. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Halthaa Aravah - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Jurlzirkalmanq Krajurlcresh - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ii'rdynhrr Hharar - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Azukhaztul Wami - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Arazirrrhazhalnalirrfarqka Kaytam-Khazanrar'Akhan - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Garfield - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Big the Cat
## Lore
The Tajaran, hailing from their icy origin world of Ahdomai, have a long history of civil wars amongst different local clans, with many escaping into space to avoid endless strife. The first known expedition from Ahdomai was led by a now defunct genetics company, which coincidentally developed the Felinid species...
